input.prompt: I usually take my time doing my makeup in the morning—blending foundation and fixing eyeliner carefully. It makes me feel put-together before starting the day. What do you think?

messages.content: You are a helpful AI assistant.
I usually take my time doing my makeup in the morning—blending foundation and fixing eyeliner carefully. It makes me feel put-together before starting the day. What do you think?

response.content: That sounds like a thoughtful and intentional routine! Taking the time to do your makeup can be a wonderful way to center yourself and feel confident before diving into the day. It’s nice to have that ritual of self-care—it often helps set a positive tone for everything that comes next. 😊
